playstyle.identity: Jax is a scaling duelist who becomes nearly unkillable late game. His Counter Strike dodges all autos, making him a nightmare for auto-attack champions.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks attack speed with autos. Q leaps to target. W empowers next auto. E dodges all autos and stuns when it ends. R gives armor/MR and empowers every third auto. Jump in, E to dodge, auto-W-auto for burst. Late game you 1v9.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jax spikes at level 6 with R resistances and with Trinity Force. He's a late-game hyperscaling duelist.

passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.summary: Auto attacks build stacks, increasing attack speed.
passive.details: Jax's basic attacks build stacks, granting bonus attack speed. Stacks fall off if Jax doesn't attack for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Leap Strike
abilities.summary: Jump to a target (ally, enemy, or ward).
abilities.details: Jax leaps to a target unit, dealing damage if it's an enemy. Can target allies, enemies, or wards.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.summary: Next auto attack deals bonus magic damage.
abilities.details: Jax empowers his next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage. Can be used as an auto reset.

abilities.name: Counter Strike
abilities.summary: Dodge all auto attacks; reactivate to stun nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Jax enters a defensive stance, dodging all basic attacks and reducing AoE damage. After 2 seconds or on recast, he stuns nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Grandmaster's Might
abilities.summary: Passive: every third auto deals bonus damage. Active: gain armor and MR.
abilities.details: Passive: Every third auto attack deals bonus magic damage. Active: Jax gains bonus armor and magic resist based on his AD and AP.
